title: HealICON: spectral and wave analysis of ICON output on the HEALPix grid
description:
HealICON is a command-line tool for wave and tidal analysis of global atmospheric simulations. It uses HEALPix as the base grid for interpolation, providing an equal-area environment for mapping tidal harmonics and gravity-wave spectra across the globe.

This release (v0.1.1) adds primitive-equation Eliassen--Palm (EP) flux wave driving diagnostics in pressure and geometric height coordinates (Hardiman et al. 2010; Edmon et al. 1980) alongside the global tidal decomposition. It provides the software used for the global tidal harmonics (Figure S2) and resolved EP-flux wave forcing analysis (Figure 4) reported in Morfa et al., Whole-atmosphere modeling with regional refinement: strengths and drawbacks assessed with observations from the VortEx campaign, Journal of Advances in Modeling Earth Systems.
